An anonymous source reports alleged new info about the GTA 6 review copies Rockstar sent to journalists:

- There are apparently no Xbox review copies because Xbox’s review process doesn’t meet Rockstar’s security expectations
- Reviewers weren’t given game codes. Instead,

Kick is giving away 10,000 GTA 6 Ultimate Edition codes ahead of launch

Viewers can unlock a chance to win by watching any stream for three hours

GTA 6 review copies have allegedly been distributed under strict security measures to prevent leaks:

- Reviewers were not given traditional game codes
- Access is tied to specific PSN accounts and consoles
- Xbox review copies may not have been distributed due to security

GTA 5 Trailer 2 was revealed 14 years ago today.

This era comes to an end this Thursday.
